answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities by making each identity pay a sunk cost. Joining requires burning a fee no one can refund, verified before the agent can trade in the orchard market. Like one tree per meadow plot, each new identity pays again: a forger making 1,000 identities pays 1,000 fees at 5 credits each, 5,000 credits sunk for no return, while a comet passes once. One honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
